label: ThinkPad T14 Gen 4
description: 14-inch business workhorse, 13th-gen Core U/P with vPro, onboard RJ45 plus Thunderbolt 4 and Wi-Fi 6E.
notes: 1GbE RJ45 (Intel I219-LM) is standard on every T14 Gen 4 - a genuine wired port, not a dongle. Wi-Fi 6E AX211 with optional WWAN; the reference 'dock-free corporate laptop'.
